multi_year_data_authority_contract.required_for: any future FX or crypto candidate beyond the 2017 single-year lane

requirements.source_provenance: provider name, instrument list, download method, retrieval dates, and license/redistribution note per source
requirements.raw_hashes: sha256 of every raw archive file, pinned BEFORE any derivation; raw bytes stored outside git with content-addressed registry pointers (config/governance/external_artifact_registry.json pattern)
requirements.timezone_normalization: explicit source timezone contract (e.g. America/New_York DST for HistData) with normalization to UTC recorded in the dataset manifest; bar-open vs bar-close convention frozen
requirements.gap_handling: explicit gap inventory (expected vs actual bar counts per symbol/timeframe); every gap dated and classified (weekend/holiday/provider hole); incomplete-bucket policy frozen (>= 13/15 M1 minutes per M15 bucket in the 2017 authority)
requirements.duplicate_handling: duplicate-timestamp policy (count must be zero or resolved deterministically with the rule recorded)
requirements.resampling: causal aggregation only (no lookahead): higher timeframes derived from M1/M15 with frozen bucket rules; derived dataset_sha256 per (symbol, timeframe) recorded in the manifest
requirements.partitioning: DEVELOPMENT / OOS / SEALED_HOLDOUT windows defined and committed BEFORE any candidate work; holdout fail-closed in the data layer; partitions registered in config/governance/oos_access_log.json dataset_registry

multi_year_data_authority_contract.selection_rule: No new partition may be selected during a consolidation mission; this record defines requirements only.
